_doc: Classes: each levels independently from kills/rounds played as it; one skill point per level. Trees unlock a tier every `tierPoints` points spent in that tree (BL4 style). Node effects add per rank to the stat keys read by mod.js (see classes.js STATS).

classes.name: Engineer
classes.tagline: Builds the defences everyone else hides behind.

action.name: Sentry Turret
action.desc: Deploy an automatic turret in front of you. It tracks and shoots the nearest zombie it can see until it runs out of power.

nodes.name: Calibrated Barrels
nodes.desc: Turret damage +{v}%.

nodes.name: Spare Capacitors
nodes.desc: Turret lasts {v}s longer.

nodes.name: Tripwire Rounds
nodes.desc: Augment: turret shots slow zombies by 40% for 1.5s.

nodes.name: Servo Motor
nodes.desc: Turret fire rate +{v}%.

nodes.name: Long Sight
nodes.desc: Turret range +{v}%.

nodes.name: Recycler
nodes.desc: Each turret kill takes {v}s off its cooldown.

nodes.name: Arc Welder
nodes.desc: Augment: turret shots arc to one more zombie nearby for half damage.

nodes.name: Overdrive
nodes.desc: Turret damage +{v}% against zombies above half health.

nodes.name: Redundancy
nodes.desc: Turret cooldown −{v}%.

nodes.name: Twin Sentries

nodes.name: Scrap Plating
nodes.desc: Take {v}% less damage.

nodes.desc: Reload {v}% faster.

nodes.name: Patch Kit

nodes.desc: Knife damage +{v}%.

nodes.name: Spare Parts

nodes.name: Hazard Pay
nodes.desc: Points earned +{v}%.

nodes.name: Lockdown

nodes.name: Grit

nodes.name: Toolbelt
nodes.desc: Turret cooldown −{v}%.

nodes.name: Flak Lining

nodes.name: Incendiary Rounds
nodes.desc: Augment: turret shots set zombies alight, burning for extra damage.

nodes.name: Shrapnel
nodes.desc: Explosion radius effects +{v}% damage at the edges.

nodes.name: Stockpile
nodes.desc: Gain {v} extra grenade(s) each round.

nodes.desc: Turret cooldown −{v}%.

nodes.name: Heavy Ordnance

nodes.name: Big Bang
